headline: Amazon unveils Echo Show 16, Echo Studio camera, Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time
summary: Amazon's Echo hardware event introduced the Alexa Photo Frame, a camera-equipped Echo Studio with visual-intelligence features and a kill switch, a new Echo Time alarm clock, and an Echo Show 16 with a glare-reducing nanomatte display and an AI-generated Alexa interface. One outlet also frames the Echo Show 16 as a response to a competing Apple device, a framing others do not use.
